opening.argument: The presentation frames Forsage as an income opportunity tied to Ethereum earnings within a matrix, including the claim that income can reach a participant's wallet even without personal referrals. It describes personally referred participants and explains that the first two positions provide money to an upline or spiller, connecting matrix placement and spillover to payouts. The presentation also shows slot structures, affiliate-link controls, ETH or dollar figures, and transaction fields consistent with that system. Those features support the claimed recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix model. The records do not independently verify the stated earnings, actual transfers, slot prices, or whether viewers are directly instructed to activate a slot.
